root_split.assignment: within every task, lexicographic root-family index modulo 3
root_split.rule_for_new_boundary_rows: inherit the fold of the same task/root family
root_split.held_root_exclusion: for each fold, neither old nor new rows from the held root may enter training
root_split.normalization: fit independently inside each training fold and arm; never use held-root rows

direct_model.head: Linear(128,64)+ReLU+Linear(64,1)
direct_model.input_schema: H=8 command/task-phase sequence plus the unchanged 54D force/physics/initial-state condition

sampling.frozen_existing_rule: inverse frequency over friction_band x outcome x stratum as implemented by task0_visual_context_early.sample_weights
sampling.new_boundary_stratum: BOUNDARY_NEW; preserved as acquisition metadata but not exposed as a model input
sampling.note: Any boundary-weighted loss is a separate optional scientific method ablation after ordinary augmentation is evaluated.

fixed_runtime.utility: unchanged task-specific Expected Utility from UTILITY_FINAL_CONFIG.json

required: task6 selected force rises only where archived/fresh paired evidence supports it
task0/task1/task5 have no comparable collateral loss
same Utility; no force-scale or threshold retuning
effect appears across at least two tasks or is classified task6-only

forbidden: boundary-weighted loss in the primary comparison
fresh TEST claim from observed 720 roots
